title: Repeat-Fee Table for Appointment Series Late Arrivals
content:
Decision table — repeat share in the late-arrival fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The late-arrival repeat share is 150 percent where the series already shows two or more missed-visit fees assessed in the two months up to the assessment date (an entry counts when fewer than two whole months separate its date from the assessment date), 125 percent where it shows exactly one such fee, and 100 percent where it shows none. The share is read as a percentage of the late-arrival basis and multiplies it.

| Missed-visit fee entries already on the series, two months up to the assessment date | Repeat share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 150 percent |
| exactly one | 125 percent |
| none | 100 percent |

**What counts.** Every missed-visit fee entry on the same series, whatever its kind, dated on the date it was assessed.

**Edge (hypothetical, assessment on 30 April).** An entry dated 1 March counts; one dated 28 February is separated from 30 April by two whole months and does not.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** Two fee entries in the period on a late-arrival basis of USD 45.00: 150 percent of USD 45.00 is USD 67.50.
